description: Establishes links between stock pickings and invoices as well as invoice lines, allowing users to track which deliveries correspond to specific invoices when invoicing sales order items with a delivery invoicing policy.
evidence: This module adds a link between pickings and invoices as well as on the lines.
ghi_chu: Đúng. Cùng tên với chức năng của stock_picking_invoice_link; khác ở bối cảnh bán hàng, chính sách xuất hoá đơn theo giao hàng

function: Fill draft picking with products from source location
description: Populates a draft picking with stock move lines for all available products in the specified source location.
evidence: On a draft picking, add a button to fill with moves lines for all products in the source destination.
ghi_chu: Đúng. 'stock move lines' theo code là stock.move (dòng mơ hồ đã ghi ở R-25)

description: Enables users to select specific quants from the product on-hand or inventory reporting views and transfer them to a designated location.
evidence: Select the quantities which you want move to another location
ghi_chu: Đúng. Trùng một phần với chức năng 'Move stock between locations via wizard' (ý 'chỉ chuyển số lượng chọn')

function: Move stock between locations via wizard
description: Transfers entire stock or selected product quantities from an origin location to a destination location using a specialized wizard, supporting both immediate and planned transfers.
evidence: This module allows to move all stock in a stock location to an other one.
ghi_chu: Đúng ý chính (DESCRIPTION: chuyển toàn bộ hoặc chỉ số lượng chọn)
can_kiem_tra: Đã kiểm chứng: USAGE.md dòng 3 "IMMEDIATE TRANSFER" or "PLANNED TRANSFER", dòng 10 "If PLANNED TRANSFER is used..."

function: Allow negative stock for individual locations
description: Enables negative stock levels for individual inventory locations by setting the Allow Negative Stock flag on the selected locations.
evidence: Go to *Inventory / Configuration / Warehouse Management / Locations* and activate the option the option *Allow Negative Stock* for the locations you choose.

function: Allow negative stock for product categories
description: Permits negative stock levels for all products within a specific category by enabling the Allow Negative Stock setting on the product category.
evidence: Go to *Inventory / Configuration / Products / Product Categories* and activate this option.

function: Allow negative stock for specific products
description: Allows negative stock levels for specific products by enabling the Allow Negative Stock option on the product form.
evidence: Go to *Inventory / Master Data / Products* and in the tab *General Information* activate this option.
ghi_chu: Đúng. LLM tách cấu hình thành 3 chức năng theo 3 phạm vi (location, category, product): chấp nhận được vì là 3 option khác nhau

function: Block stock operations resulting in negative stock
description: Prevents stock operations such as stock moves, pickings, or manufacturing orders from being validated if they would result in a negative stock level for stockable products or locations.
evidence: When you validate a stock operation (a stock move, a picking, a manufacturing order, etc.) that will set the stock level of a stockable product as negative, you will be blocked by an error message.
ghi_chu: Đúng; khớp cả đoạn 2 của DESCRIPTION. 'stockable' là thuật ngữ cũ (Odoo 18 dùng is_storable)

function: Auto create lots for incoming stock pickings
description: Automatically generates lot numbers when validating incoming stock pickings for tracked products configured with auto lot creation, removing the need for manual lot entry.
evidence: This module extends the functionality of stock module to allow auto create lots for incoming pickings.
ghi_chu: Đúng. Mô tả chỉ nêu điều kiện trên sản phẩm, chưa nêu cấu hình trên loại phiếu (field stock.picking.type.auto_create_lot đã được gắn ở R-23)

description: Allows users to reset canceled inventory transfers back to the draft state by clicking a button on the canceled picking.
evidence: This module allows to bring canceled transfers back to draft

description: Establishes a link between stock pickings and invoices at both the header and line levels, providing visibility of related pickings in a dedicated tab on the invoice.
evidence: The base module used by sale_stock_picking_invoice_link and purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link to adds a link between pickings and invoices as well as on the lines.
can_kiem_tra: Đã kiểm chứng: USAGE.md dòng 4 "If you open invoice form, you must see a new Pickings tab"

ghi_chu: DESCRIPTION của 2 module (Minh gửi 23/11): không thấy chức năng bị bỏ sót
